name: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)
when_to_use: Clustering when groups may overlap; instead of hard assignment (like k-means, already cataloged in 05-clustering-nao-hierarquico), estimates the probability of each case belonging to each group.
notes: Clustering that, instead of hard groups, gives the probability of each case belonging to each group. Applications: customer segmentation with overlapping profiles.

expected_input.question: What is the probability of a case belonging to each of several latent groups?

plain_explanation.purpose: Groups items allowing each to belong partially to several groups.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When groups overlap and you want a probability, not just a label.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Numeric table, one item per row.
plain_explanation.example: Segment customers who sit between two profiles.
